en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a small steam locomotive pulling a freight train loaded with logs and boxcars along narrow‑gauge tracks through a rural, forested landscape. Tall birch and conifer trees flank the line, with a dirt track beside the rails and a simple track switch in the foreground. Light smoke rises from the locomotive's chimney. There are no prominent buildings, only natural scenery and railway infrastructure.
